answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can meter identity by heartbeat: every agent must lock a small verifiable deposit and emit a signed liveness pulse once per epoch, tying one identity to one ongoing cost. Fake identities flood in like a tide, but each new account must fund escrow before it can join the river of paid tasks, and duplicates are caught when two pulses sign from the same stake. An attacker can still spawn bots, but each one costs real escrow slashed on fraud, so the marginal fake identity pays more than it earns.
